author: Yffe
content:
Fixed in check.rs: the verus L3 path now runs in a PER-RUN SCRATCH DIRECTORY removed WHOLESALE on every exit path.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed by probe): on a CLEAN verus exit, verus compiles the lowered .rs into a ~4.3M binary SIBLING (<stem>, no extension) in its working dir. The v0.1 run_verus/invoke_verus ran verus with .current_dir(std::env::temp_dir()) and removed ONLY the .rs source, orphaning that 4.3M binary directly in the shared temp dir on every successful verify -> unbounded /tmp growth (the #18/#20 ENOSPC).

FIX (symbol anchors, forge/src/check.rs):
- new struct ScratchDir { path } + impl Drop -> best-effort remove_dir_all (R-CODE-2, never panics), fires on EVERY exit path incl. a ? early-return.
- unique_temp_path -> unique_scratch_dir (a DIRECTORY forge_<stem>_<pid>_<n>, pid+counter, no wall-clock R-CODE-5).
- run_verus writes <stem>.rs (no-. crate_stem, crate-name gotcha intact) INSIDE the scratch dir; invoke_verus(cwd, tmp, ..) runs verus with current_dir = cwd (scratch dir) so the compiled binary lands inside; the ScratchDir Drop removes source + binary + all artifacts wholesale.

KANI (class check): kani.rs already runs in a per-run scratch CRATE removed wholesale via run_kani's remove_dir_all(&crate_dir) on all paths -> NO leak, unchanged.

SIBLING LEAK FOUND (needs manifest): forge/src/vacuity_solver.rs (run_harness/invoke_verus_on_harness/unique_temp_path) has the IDENTICAL leak -- runs verus with .current_dir(std::env::temp_dir()), removes only the .rs. The #13 gate runs it on every fn before L3, and a Proved harness query leaves the same 4.3M binary. Same class, file NOT on this blocker's manifest -> reporting per the 'STOP+report if you need it on the manifest' protocol rather than silently editing a third file.

REGRESSION TEST: forge/tests/scratch_cleanup.rs -- success path (sum.th, L3 clean exit, the 4.3M-binary case) + error path (counterexample, exit 1), each in an isolated TMPDIR asserting no surviving forge_* entry. Skip-loud if verus absent.

GAUNTLET (verus present): build clean; cargo test -p forge 166 unit + all integration pass incl. 2 new; cargo test --workspace 0 failures; clippy -D warnings clean; fmt --check clean. Corpus still certifies sum->L3, binary_search->L3 (check_conformance 4/4).
